results.title: Current time in GMT+8 | Time.now
results.content:
GMT+8 is a fixed UTC offset of exactly 8 hours ahead of Coordinated Universal Time. Unlike named time zones such as China Standard Time or Singapore Time, GMT+8 does not observe daylight saving time in most regions, though a few areas shift to this offset only during DST. This page covers the regions, cities, and practical scheduling details for this heavily populated offset.

### What Does a Fixed UTC Offset Mean? [...] ## What is GMT+8?

GMT+8 means Greenwich Mean Time 8 hours ahead of the Greenwich meridian, the historical reference line running through the Royal Observatory in London. GMT offsets are the everyday way many countries, broadcasters, and travel timetables describe their local time relative to the UK. [...] ⏱️ Time.now
